| Step | What happens | Why it matters |
|------|--------------|----------------|

| **Start engine** | The engine control unit (ECU) receives the ignition command. It checks that the brake is fully engaged, then energizes the starter motor. | Prevents the engine from cranking if the brake isn’t engaged, avoiding potential damage or safety hazards. |
| **Release brake** | The brake actuator returns to the neutral position. | Allows the driver to use the brake normally once the engine is running. |
| **Display logs** | The vehicle’s infotainment system shows a summary of recent actions. | Provides feedback to the driver and helps diagnose issues if something goes wrong. |
